title: Lakhanpur (J&K) Selected as First Town for PM SVANidhi Street Food Hub
summary: Establishes modern street food hub under Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs initiative.

blocks.text: 🪝 Lakhanpur (J&K) Selected as First Town for PM SVANidhi Street Food Hub. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Establishes modern street food hub under Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs initiative.
Financial Grant: ₹4 crore financial assistance released in 3 installments (30:50:20 ratio).
ULB Incentive: Urban local bodies notifying street vending plans receive ₹25 lakh bonus incentive.
Partner Agencies: Coordinated by MoHUA, Ministry of Tourism, and FSSAI.
PM SVANidhi street food hub grant (₹4 crore) vs ULB incentive (₹25 lakh).
